source.subject: feat: establish C512 Prefill request boundary

compatibility_fixes: FP8 attention-output selection is explicitly C64 and no longer aliases the request maximum.
NVFP4 down selection is explicitly C64; C256/C512 retain ordered M32 fallback until their narrow routes are promoted.
Residual plus RMS fusion preserves ordered M32 boundaries for every C32 multiple through C512.
A large full-attention tile keeps the causally eligible prefix through position 64 on the existing fused per-token GQA/Gate route, while only the suffix uses reference GQA plus tile Gate.
C128, C192, and C320 request caps decompose into the explicit production palette instead of entering unsupported wide routes.

next: route exact C256/C512 full-attention tiles to the selected bulk causal GQA production API on SM87
promote exact C256/C512 NVFP4 Gate/Up and down narrow routes while retaining current fallback
run P257/P513/P769/P1025 full-model exact-output and persistent-state validation
publish fixed-clock end-to-end Prefix results before enabling C512 as the performance default

limitations: The ABI and scheduler are production code, but C256/C512 currently use existing narrow-kernel fallback loops unless an already supported exact C64 subroute applies.
C256/C512 model E2E tests are registered but skipped in this run because Q3X_E2E_MODEL_DIR was not configured.
The default Prefill chunk remains C1, so this commit alone is not a performance promotion.
No end-to-end throughput improvement is claimed.
